top_stories.title: 16-year-old researcher breaks into Microsoft analytics service with access to 17 trillion rows of data
top_stories.summary: A 16-year-old security researcher discovered a critical JWT signature verification flaw in Microsoft's internal Titan analytics service, allowing unauthorized access to 17.3 trillion rows of data across 17 databases. The vulnerability stemmed from Titan's failure to verify login token signatures, enabling the researcher to impersonate the service administrator and execute arbitrary SQL queries against connected databases.

top_stories.title: IAM for AI agents: A Practical Enterprise Framework
top_stories.summary: This article presents a framework for applying identity and access management principles to AI agents operating within enterprise environments. It covers authentication, delegated authority, provisioning limitations, and runtime governance components specific to agentic AI systems.

top_stories.title: JADEPUFFER-Linked Attackers Used Compromised Service Principals to Delete Azure Resources
top_stories.summary: Threat actor JADEPUFFER (tracked by Microsoft as Storm-3168) used compromised Azure service principals to conduct destructive operations within a Microsoft Azure environment over approximately 18 hours in early June 2026. The attack highlights abuse of service principal identities—non-human IAM entities used for application authentication and authorization—as a vector for destructive cloud actions.

top_stories.title: Storm-3168: Agentic-driven cloud attacks using compromised service principals
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has detailed attack activity by Storm-3168 (linked to JADEPUFFER) involving compromised Azure service principals used for cloud reconnaissance, resource deletion, and credential access. The report includes defender guidance related to service principal security within Microsoft's cloud identity infrastructure.

top_stories.title: AI Agents Are Privileged Users; Who Is Auditing Their Access?
top_stories.summary: The article examines how autonomous AI agents are operating with broad privileged access within enterprises without the same auditing and governance controls applied to human users. The piece frames AI agents as a emerging PAM and identity governance challenge, raising questions about access oversight, privilege management, and insider threat risk.

news.title: Hottest cybersecurity open-source tools of the month: September 2026
news.summary: Help Net Security published its September 2026 roundup of notable open-source cybersecurity tools. The selection includes Sift, a credential and secrets scanning tool that searches Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, Active Directory domains, and SharePoint for exposed passwords and API keys.

news.title: Official MCP Python SDK Flaw Can Let Malicious Servers Steal OAuth Credentials
news.summary: A security flaw in the official MCP Python SDK allowed malicious servers to steal OAuth credentials including client secrets, authorization codes, and PKCE proof keys by redirecting them to an attacker-controlled token endpoint. The vulnerability has been patched in version 1.30.0 and later.

news.title: JadePuffer AI Actor Compromises Azure Tenant in Destructive Cloud Attack
news.summary: A threat actor identified as "JadePuffer" compromised an Azure tenant in a destructive cloud attack, deleting cloud-based storage, applications, and databases. The attacker reportedly used exposed credentials to gain unauthorized access, highlighting risks around credential exposure and cloud identity security in Microsoft Azure environments.

news.title: Over 16,000 Supabase databases expose PII, passwords, auth tokens
news.summary: Researchers discovered over 16,000 misconfigured Supabase databases with publicly readable tables containing PII, passwords, and authentication tokens. The exposure stems from misconfiguration of the open-source backend platform, which is commonly used for authentication and user data storage.

news.title: JadePuffer agentic AI attacks target Azure, destroy cloud resources
news.summary: A threat actor called JadePuffer is conducting agentic AI-driven ransomware attacks targeting Azure tenants. The attacks involve credential theft and reconnaissance against Azure environments, directly impacting identity and access security in Microsoft cloud infrastructure.

news.title: 80,000+ Organizations Had AI Logins Stolen: From Shadow AI to LLMjacking
news.summary: Infostealer malware logs have exposed AI account credentials and session tokens tied to over 80,000 corporate domains. The stolen credentials enable threats including unauthorized access to AI platform accounts and LLMjacking, where attackers hijack authenticated AI sessions for illicit use.

news.title: FBI job portals remain offline after ShinyHunters claims breach via PeopleSoft zero-day
news.summary: ShinyHunters claims to have breached FBI job portals using an unspecified Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day vulnerability, taking the apply.fbijobs.gov and fbijobs.gov/special-agents portals offline. The FBI has confirmed it is investigating the breach, which ShinyHunters says exposed personal information of FBI employees.

news.title: Webinar: How to Govern AI Agents, Reduce Excessive Access, and Control Shadow AI
news.summary: A webinar is being promoted that addresses governing AI agents, reducing excessive access, and controlling shadow AI in enterprise environments. The content references Okta's Global CISO Insights 2026 report, citing that only 47% of CISOs are confident they can identify every AI agent in their environment.

news.title: CISA Says Attackers Are Exploiting Two Critical Citrix NetScaler Flaws Globally
news.summary: CISA has added two critical Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active global exploitation. The flaws include CVE-2026-88771 (CVSS 9.5), an improper input validation vulnerability exploitable by unauthenticated attackers, directly impacting network access control infrastructure used for authentication and secure remote access.

news.title: New in Symfony 8.2: OpenID Connect Login
news.summary: Symfony 8.2 is introducing native OpenID Connect (OIDC) login support, allowing applications to delegate authentication to identity providers such as Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, and Microsoft Entra ID. This builds on OIDC token handler support added in Symfony 6.3, expanding the framework's built-in integration with standard IAM protocols.

news.title: Authorizer: Open-source authentication and authorization for your apps
news.summary: Authorizer is an open-source authentication and authorization server designed for web and mobile applications, allowing teams to self-host on their own infrastructure with a choice of database backend. The project includes a permissions engine, support for AI agent integration, and covers core IAM functions including sign-in and access control.

news.title: Zero Trust for AI Agents Starts With Fixing Zero Visibility
news.summary: The article addresses applying Zero Trust principles to AI agents, arguing that lack of visibility is the foundational security problem to solve first. It references a notable intrusion at Hugging Face during an OpenAI agent evaluation as a catalyst for organizations rethinking how they implement identity and access controls for AI agents.

news.title: PamStealer macOS Malware Adds Live C2 Payload Decryption and Multi-Layer Persistence
news.summary: Cybersecurity researchers at Jamf Threat Labs have identified a new version of PamStealer macOS malware that uses server-side decryption chains to protect its main payload and adds multi-layer persistence mechanisms. The malware uses a JavaScript for Automation (JXA) dropper mechanism and targets credential and sensitive data theft on macOS systems.

news.title: WSO2 and Adobe Commerce Flaws Exploited in Attacks, Added to CISA KEV
news.summary: CISA added two critical vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, including CVE-2026-5430, a path traversal flaw (CVSS 9.8) in WSO2 API Control Plane, alongside an Adobe Commerce/Magento flaw. WSO2 is an open-source identity and API management platform, making this relevant to IAM professionals who may have WSO2 deployments in their environments.

news.title: Vanderbilt University extends identity governance to AI agents
news.summary: Vanderbilt University is extending its identity governance framework to cover AI agents as they enter institutional workflows. The university's implementation uses OneVU, powered by Okta, to manage the changing relationships between people, institutions, and AI technology.

news.title: AWS IAM outbound identity federation now supports interface VPC endpoints for OIDC discovery
news.summary: AWS IAM has added support for interface VPC endpoints for OIDC discovery APIs in its outbound identity federation feature. This allows access to OIDC discovery metadata and JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) verification through Amazon Virtual Private Cloud endpoints, enabling private network access without traversing the public internet.

news.title: Half a Dozen Analysts Have a Buy Signal on Okta
news.summary: Six Wall Street analysts issued or maintained Buy-equivalent ratings on Okta following the Oktane 2026 conference, with multiple firms raising their price targets. The article covers analyst sentiment and stock price targets for the IAM vendor rather than product or technical developments.

news.title: Ghost Service Accounts Enable M365 Data Theft in Chile
news.summary: Ghost (forgotten/abandoned) service accounts in Microsoft 365 environments are being exploited to enable data theft in Chilean organizations. The attack vector highlights how unmanaged service accounts can bypass otherwise secured employee account controls, compromising entire M365 environments.

news.title: These startups are building the security layer for AI agents
news.summary: Okta has expanded its controls for governing AI agents as part of a broader industry push to secure enterprise AI agent deployments. The article covers emerging startups and established IAM vendors addressing authentication and authorization challenges specific to AI agents operating within enterprise environments.

news.title: The PGA of America limits AI sprawl with a streamlined identity architecture
news.summary: The PGA of America implemented a streamlined identity architecture to manage AI agent access across enterprise systems. The case study focuses on how a smaller technology team addressed identity security challenges introduced by AI agents operating within their infrastructure.

news.title: Okta turns Dex AI agent into a customer-zero proving ground
news.summary: Okta has deployed its Dex AI agent internally as both an employee support tool and a testbed for its own identity controls, after exceeding a goal of saving 250,000 employee hours. The company has raised its 2025 target to 1 million hours saved, using the internal deployment to validate the identity and access management capabilities it offers customers.

news.title: AI agents creating a new insider security risk: theCUBE’s Oktane keynote analysis
news.summary: theCUBE's analysis of Okta's Oktane keynote highlights AI agents as an emerging insider security risk due to their ability to act across applications and delegate tasks to other agents faster than security teams can review. The discussion centers on the need for visibility and permission limits to manage AI agent access, directly intersecting with IAM concepts like authorization and least-privilege access controls.

news.title: Microsoft Disrupts EvilTokens Device Code Phishing Service
news.summary: Microsoft seized 50 websites and disabled over 150 domains to disrupt EvilTokens, a phishing-as-a-service platform targeting Microsoft 365 accounts. The operation focused on device code phishing, a technique that hijacks OAuth authentication flows to steal tokens and bypass MFA protections.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million drivers licenses from the US and Canada, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has launched an official inquiry into the breach, which affects a widely-used identity verification provider.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to customer accounts and included the theft of call and text records from over 100 million AT&T customers.
